subject.title: fix(onboard): require viable imported and local inference

question: Should automatic first-run inference selection require measured tool support and a 16K effective context, with failed imported routes forced back into provider repair rather than allowed to continue?
rationale: This is a deliberate fresh-onboarding behavior change rather than a mechanical compatibility repair; tests establish the proposed behavior, but the minimum threshold and fail-closed setup experience require maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Approve the stricter onboarding eligibility
options.body: Keep the 16K measured-context floor and required import verification, then require the missing LM Studio live proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve broader auto-selection
options.body: Retain automatic eligibility for smaller or unknown-context local models and limit this PR to live verification of imported routes.

recommendation.title: Approve the stricter onboarding eligibility
recommendation.body: Keep the 16K measured-context floor and required import verification, then require the missing LM Studio live proof before merge.
